beats.event: Father dead; uncle Claudius is now king and married to his mother
Claudius reproaches Hamlet for prolonged grief
Ghost of King Hamlet reveals he was murdered by Claudius
Hamlet vows revenge; plans to feign madness
Ophelia rejects him on her father's orders
Rosencrantz and Guildenstern arrive to spy on him
Hamlet commissions play to expose Claudius's guilt
Cruelly denounces Ophelia in a staged encounter
Play succeeds; Claudius flees, confirming guilt
Spares Claudius at prayer to deny him heaven
Accidentally stabs Polonius behind the curtain
Claudius ships him to England for execution
Ophelia goes mad after her father's death
Laertes returns enraged; Claudius plots a poisoned duel
Gertrude drinks poisoned wine meant for Hamlet
Poisoned by Laertes's blade; finally kills Claudius
Dies in Horatio's arms, naming Fortinbras his successor
